title: Chicken Skewers with French Inspiration
description: A classic French-inspired dish made with tender chicken, flavorful seasoning, and grilled to perfection. Perfect for a light and refreshing meal or as an appetizer for a dinner party.

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.amount: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces

ingredients.name: croatian paprika
ingredients.notes: smoked paprika for added depth of flavor

ingredients.name: skewers
ingredients.notes: soaked in water for at least 30 minutes

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, paprika, salt, pepper, and garlic. Add the chicken and toss to coat.
Thread the chicken onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill grates with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Transfer the skewers to a plate and brush with lemon juice. Serve immediately.
